Hyperbolic interpolation on each unit cell gives T=M_delta T_integer; M's symmetric/antisymmetric eigenvalues are m and p. Two-cell Floquet symbol C(theta) yields S=M C(theta)^2 M. Characteristic-polynomial trace/determinant sign factorizations at m²tanh²(alpha), p²tanh²(alpha) isolate the two continuous bands; common eigenvectors at theta=0 attain the global extrema, theta=pi attains interior endpoints. Squared coefficient-norm bounds A=sinh²(alpha(1/2-delta))/cosh²(alpha/2), B=cosh²(alpha(1/2-delta))/sinh²(alpha/2) and the quadratic site-collision limit are correctly normalized for alpha>0, 0<=delta<1/2. Independent direct 2x2 Bloch calculations for four (alpha,delta) pairs matched all four extremities, not used as an all-frequency proof. At delta=0 bands touch; the limit delta->1/2 is singular. The signed formulas, rather than a finite scan, carry infinite-volume conclusion.
